ledger.summary: The host reaches Wulstead near sunset. The town, once unwalled, is now fenced with pales, with two timber towers at the gate and a barrier of beams. Wulstead is not in Upmeads' lands but is a friendly neighbour. Ralph and Ursula walk up to the barrier, and Clement Chapman comes out, embraces Ralph and kneels to Ursula. Clement says about two thousand Burgers lie beyond; Upmeads was still free that morning. Ralph's parents have been lodged in the House of Black Canons inside the walls for two days, with other women, children and old men. Nicholas Longshanks leads the carles holding the High House. Wulstead will send a band. Ursula carries the hallowed guisarme at the head of the host as it enters.
ledger.geography_notes: Wulstead stands on a little hill or swelling, approached across plain meadows with few trees, so anyone coming is seen from the gate. It is now fenced with pales, with two timber gate towers and a barrier of big beams before the gate. It lies outside Upmeads' lands.
